  SELECT geoid, name
  FROM fw_pg.tracts

viol_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_81f3ac'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
cdc_data AS (
  SELECT tractfips,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,

  FROM session.fw_81f3ac_m2_cdc
)
SELECT t.geoid,
  t.name,
  COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
  c.totalpopulation,
  (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / NULLIF(c.totalpopulation, 0)) * 1000 AS code_violation_rate_per_1000,
  c.prevalence AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR((COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / NULLIF(c.totalpopulation, 0)) * 1000, c.prevalence) OVER () AS correlation_coefficient,
  COUNT(*) OVER (WHERE (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / NULLIF(c.totalpopulation, 0)) * 1000 IS NOT NULL AND c.prevalence IS NOT NULL) AS paired_tracts

LEFT JOIN cdc_data c ON t.geoid = c.tractfips
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000 DESC,
  t.name
